decision.thesis: NO TRADE. THE 00:00 NOTE'S FALSIFIABLE QUESTION IS ANSWERED, AND THE ANSWER IS 'RECLAIMED, THEN LOST AGAIN' - SO THE SHORT'S PREMISE IS GONE AND THE LONG THAT REPLACES IT FAILS ON FOUR INDEPENDENT GROUNDS. The 00:00 note asked of the 16:05Z bounce: did it build a HIGHER LOW above 760.09 and RECLAIM 766.72, or fail underneath it and roll over? BOTH BRANCHES PARTLY FIRED AND THE NOTE'S INSTRUCTION FOR THE RECLAIM BRANCH IS THE ONE THAT BINDS. Trace since 16:05Z: the 760.09 low HELD; 16:20Z-17:10Z did make lower highs under the level (766.65 -> 766.03 -> 766.08 -> 766.07 -> 765.17 -> 765.94 -> 764.31 -> 763.79) with a 762.63 low at 17:05Z, which is the failure branch the note wanted; but the 17:15Z 5m bar then went 763.74 -> 766.44 as a 0.354% body on 998,020 volume, and 766.72 WAS RECLAIMED AND HELD: 17:25Z closed 766.89 above it, 17:45Z (L767.11) and 17:50Z (L767.09) traded ENTIRELY above it, and 17:50Z printed 767.92, the highest since 15:15Z. The 18:00Z bar then failed back under (L765.63, C765.98) and price is 766.00-766.66 now, PINNED ON THE LEVEL. PER THE 00:00 NOTE'S OWN INSTRUCTION - 'if instead 766.72 is reclaimed and HELD, say explicitly that the short's premise is gone' - I SAY IT EXPLICITLY: THE BNB SHORT'S PREMISE IS GONE. The lower-high sequence 769.49->769.03->768.27->766.70->764.05->762.97->761.64 that was the short's ONLY premise ended at 16:05Z, was briefly re-formed 16:20Z-17:10Z, and was then REPLACED BY A HIGHER-HIGH SEQUENCE 766.44 -> 766.92 -> 767.26 -> 767.30 -> 767.57 -> 767.92. No short is priced this check. AND 766.72 IS NOW A MAGNET, WHICH L-002 ADDRESSES DIRECTLY ('the same applies to a stop that sits just above or below a level the market keeps touching'): it has been touched or crossed at 15:20Z L766.74, 15:25Z O766.74, 15:30Z H766.69, 15:35Z H766.70, 16:20Z H766.65, 17:20Z H766.92, 17:25Z C766.89, 17:30Z O766.89, 17:55Z L766.18, 18:00Z C765.98 and the live quote - ELEVEN TOUCHES IN 165 MINUTES. Any stop anchored there is unusable in either direction. THE ONLY CANDIDATE THIS CHECK HAD WAS THEREFORE A BNBUSDT LONG, AND IT IS REFUSED FOUR TIMES OVER. (1) L-004 TARGET VALIDITY - THE PRIMARY REFUSAL, RUN BEFORE ANY RATIO. The only target that can pay 1.5 net from a noise-safe stop is 777.18 (the 12:00Z/13:00Z 1h lows, broken support turned resistance). It is reached ONLY BY JUMPING TWO LEVELS THAT BOTH REJECTED TODAY: 767.92, rejected TWENTY MINUTES BEFORE THIS CHECK, and 769.03, rejected three hours before it en route to the 760.09 low. The lesson is explicit that a target reached only by jumping intervening structure is not a target, and this is the cleanest instance yet because one of the two jumped levels rejected INSIDE THE SAME HOUR AS THE DECISION. (2) L-004 SPAN SCREEN ON THE HONEST TIGHT STOP - REFUSED BY 0.283 PERCENTAGE POINTS, a FOURTEEN-FOLD wider miss than the 0.020pp of 00:00. The structurally honest stop for a 'reclaim + higher low' long is below 762.63, the 17:05Z low from which the reclaim leg launched; use 762.40. The NEAREST structural target above is 769.03. Span = 6.63 points on a 766.51 entry = 0.865%. Required = 2.5N + 0.14% drag = 2.5 x 0.403 + 0.14 = 1.148%. THE STRUCTURE OFFERS 0.865% WHERE 1.148% IS NEEDED. Priced out, that construction pays NET 0.35. (3) L-003 REQUOTE, MATERIAL FOR A TENTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK, AND IN THE LEGITIMATE DIRECTION THIS TIME. On the FIXED honest wide construction (stop 759.90 below the 24h low, target 777.18), four quotes across 303 seconds: ask 765.98 -> 766.51 -> 766.70 -> 766.50 took NET RR 1.666 -> 1.452 -> 1.383 -> 1.455. THE FIRST QUOTE WAS THE ONLY ONE THAT CLEARED THE 1.5 FLOOR, AND IT CLEARED IT BY 0.166. HAD THIS CHECK ACTED ON ITS FIRST QUOTE IT WOULD HAVE TAKEN A TRADE THAT ITS NEXT THREE QUOTES ALL REFUSE. This is the lesson's LEGITIMATE form, the mirror of the RESCUE form recorded at 00:00: price advanced AWAY from the stop, so risk GREW 6.08 -> 6.80 points while reward shrank 11.20 -> 10.48, and chasing it would mean widening risk to hold the same target. Note that even the best of the four, 1.452, is BELOW the floor; only the pre-requote 1.666 ever passed. Clock stays at ZERO. (4) L-005 EXECUTION, REFUSING INDEPENDENTLY OF ALL GEOMETRY FOR A NINTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK. Five sweeps in 303 seconds and NOT ONE OF THE FIVE CONTRACTS HELD BOTH SIDES QUOTED ACROSS ALL FIVE. BNB IS THE BINDING ONE BECAUSE A LONG BUYS INTO THE ASK, AND BNB'S ASK PRINTED 7.67 USDT (0.01 BNB) AT SAMPLE 4 - a maximum 2,500 USDT market buy is 326x THE ENTIRE VISIBLE ASK - at a spread of 0.522 bps, and its bid (the exit side of that long) then fell to 39,979 USDT at sample 5 from 4,973,531 at sample 3, a 124x collapse. BNB had held both sides across samples 1-3 and was the only contract to do so; IT FAILED AT SAMPLE 4, so three healthy samples again meant nothing. XRPUSDT IS THE STRONGEST PERSISTENCE INSTANCE OF THE EXPERIMENT: its bid was unquoted on FOUR CONSECUTIVE SAMPLES (267.47 / 247.07 / 247.17 / 22.29 USDT) - not a collapse-and-recover but a book that never returned inside the check. BTCUSDT was gone on the ask at THREE of five (84.20 / 70,831 / 33.70 USDT) while quoting 0.012 bps at sample 4, the tightest spread of the check on an ask worth 70k and then 34 dollars, and its bid collapsed 24,070,823 -> 244,485 USDT in 78 seconds. SOLUSDT was unquoted on BOTH sides at sample 5 (bid 19.42, ask 51.42). ETHUSDT's ask printed 29.31 USDT at sample 2 AT 0.60 bps - the same pathology as 00:00 but on the opposite side, so ETH has now been caught unquoted on the bid (00:00, five of five) and on the ask (this check). L-002 IS WHY NO TIGHTER STOP RESCUES THE RATIO. N is stated three ways below; the honest figure is 0.403%, the 17:15Z reclaim bar, which IS the setup-defining bar - the honest case where the two coincide. The only stop that would lift the tight construction over the floor is 765.20, below the 17:35Z low: that is 0.171% = 0.42x N, SUB-NOISE, and it sits inside the 18:00Z bar's own range. Both ends of L-004's predicted trade-off observed again: the noise-safe stop kills the ratio, the ratio-passing stop is a position size. L-006 CONTRAST CASE - A WINDOW MOVED AND THE READING DID NOT DISSOLVE, THE FIRST SUCH INSTANCE. The 00:00 note forecast IN WRITING that both of its defining bars (15:35Z 0.415%, 16:05Z which closed at 0.541%) would age out of the preceding hour by ~17:05Z and that N would fall toward 0.20-0.27% IF NOTHING NEW PRINTED. They did age out. N MEASURED 0.403%, NOT 0.20-0.27% - because something new DID print: the 17:15Z reclaim bar, a genuine 0.403% directional move on 998,020 volume, 2.5x the ~400k average of its neighbours. THE FORECAST'S ARITHMETIC AND ITS CONDITIONAL WERE BOTH CORRECT, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME UNDER THIS LESSON A RE-MEASUREMENT SURVIVED. Whether that advances L-006's clock is THE REVIEW'S CALL, NOT THIS CHECK'S; the lesson binds in full here and every figure below is measured against the setup-containing window.
